page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the right margin (faint, mostly illegible show-through and a few reference marks); printed page number at the head; a ruled line with a small bottom block of faint text and the catchword "Cap." at the lower right of the text area.

main_text.p: {f}imo neque e nisi ex revelatione divina competere possit,) inde fit quod Horum preces flagitamus, Illorum ambiendas neutiquam censemus. a Eph. 6. 19. Jac. 5. 16. b If. 63. 16. c Luc. 15. 7.
A. In quo munus suum exercet Christus Propheticum?

B. Non tantum a multa praedicendo, quae aut post evenerunt, aut certò creduntur eventura; verumetiam b docendo populum suum, eosque in omnem veritatem ducendo ad salutem necessariam. a Mat. 24. 2. & c. 21. 43. Joh. 16. 33. Mat. 25. a v. 31. ad fin. b Joh. 15. 15.
B. Intus spiritu, ut causa principali; extra verbo, ut instrumentali, If. 29. 21.

page.notes: The lower half of the page (below the rule) is faint show-through from the reverse side and is not transcribed. Marginal reference marks at the right are partly illegible. The leading word "{f}imo" is the printed large initial "Ultimo" fragment, partly illegible; the first letter is uncertain. The note "e" after "neque" is a reference mark, not a word.
